I tried to wait it out, but after 30 minutes, I had to wash it off my face. This is what it looked like after I washed it off. The next morning I had small bumps all over my face that took about a week to clear. I have one teen and one preteen that I had try it. My preteen reacted the same. She had a bad reaction to it as well. My teen however, did not. She was totally fine. She has been using it for the last week and likes it a lot. Neither my preteen or I have sensitive skin, so this was very odd. Based off my teens review, she said it's great! It absorbs well, keeps her skin nice, and she loves that it's trendy. For my preteen and I, we won't be trying it again. We use other products with salicylic acid and have never had any issues, so I don't think that's the case at all. I regret to say, I think it's the Byoma formula itself. I wasn't fond of the smell either. Reminded me of a hotel bar of soap and felt sticky on my skin. If you're looking for a moisturizer that balances hydration with blemish control, this one is definitely worth trying. I'd happily repurchase it and recommend it to anyone with combination or acne-prone skin.
